answer: Each AI agent anchors its identity to a cryptographic vault whose access logs form a river of time‑stamped proofs; any new node must link its vault to an existing summit of proven agents by co‑signing a joint transaction. The network cross‑checks these signatures against a grove of shared payment sources, rejecting any pattern that diverges from the established flow. An attacker must acquire multiple funded vaults and synchronize their timestamps, inflating cost linearly with each fake identity.
